title: Touch panel and missing dial usability
summary: Feedback centers on the move from a dial-based controller to a touch-focused center control panel, with clear complaints about awkward operation and driving distraction but many fragments that are too brief or ambiguous to classify confidently.

negative.summary: Negative reviews describe the touch or control panel as awkward, hard to reach, and distracting or dangerous to use while driving.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mention the touch panel, control panel, or missing dial without enough context for a confident sentiment label, though some imply preference for the older controller layout.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are labeled undetermined, limiting confidence in a clearer sentiment read.
Some undetermined examples suggest positive or negative leanings, but the provided labels prevent reassigning them.
One fragment about calling an emergency center appears unrelated to panel or dial usability, so the topic cluster may include some noise.
